opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year one and £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK, must hold a doctorate and have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have been based at a UK university or eligible research institute and are resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million (each award funds up to 18 doctoral scholarships and additional activities)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides substantial funding for interdisciplinary doctoral scholarships and related activities.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (with research degree‑awarding powers) may submit a single application; collaborations between institutions are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports the establishment of large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres to achieve step‑change scholarship.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (full‑time) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established, distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Supports senior researchers to complete a piece of original research, especially where routine duties have limited research time.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for innovative research projects up to five years, with a focus on fundamental, curiosity‑driven work.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (with research degree‑awarding powers) may apply to host an eminent overseas professor; specialist arts institutions are excluded.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite senior overseas professors for visits that enhance skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical and clinical research)

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers who are resident in the UK and hold a post at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for experienced researchers to complete a piece of original research, especially where teaching duties have limited research time.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities that deliver fine and performing arts training for school‑age children (under 18).
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training programmes for financially‑needful school‑age students outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Bursaries £5,000 – £10,000 per year per student; maximum total award £475,000 per institution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities that award undergraduate or postgraduate bursaries in fine and performing arts.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated) who have at least two years post‑PhD experience and have not previously led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership.
